facts.fact: IFC's review summary says WIOCC's Open Access Data Centres operates 6 data centres in South Africa, Nigeria and DRC, and IFC visited the operating Lagos (Lekki) data centre, where a new block is to be built; the document is dated 2026-05-13 and gives no opening date, so that date is used.

note: Tier 3/4 Uptime Institute redundancy is stated for WIOCC data centres as a group, not for NGA by name or as a certification, so no tier3 fact; new Lagos block is planned.
